name: LEGENDS #1

date.source: The broadcast's own dateline, billed throughout as the promotion's first-ever card.

venue: LEGENDS Arena, St. Mark's School campus, Southborough, Massachusetts

matches.note: First-round tournament bout. Zack Sharp won by submission with the Concentrated Pain armbar.
First-round tournament bout. LOCO won by pinfall with the Hellraiser off the top rope, after reversing a top-rope piledriver attempt.
First-round tournament bout; the bout's own play-by-play does not survive in the held record, only the broadcast's own on-air reference to Phantom advancing.
First-round tournament bout. Terry Storm won by submission with the 12 Gauge.
Tournament semifinal. Terry Storm won by submission with a leg-lock sleeper after a top-rope hurricanrana.
Tournament semifinal, contested under the card's own no-disqualification terms. Zack Sharp won by submission with the STF at 21:37.

Two-out-of-three-falls match for the promotion's own first Worcester County Championship. Carlos Manticore won the second fall; the deciding third fall ended in a near-simultaneous double-down after a double cross-body block, with the ring announcer crediting Manticore as champion.
Tournament final for the promotion's own first Heavyweight Championship. Zack Sharp won by pinfall with a dragon suplex bridge at 32:45.

evidence.note: An eight-man single-elimination tournament crowning the promotion's own first Heavyweight Champion, alongside a separate three-way match crowning its own first Worcester County Champion.
